items.title: 恢复 truth_* 命令的 CLI 注册和可见性
items.context: 当前 help 里没有 Truth 分组命令，但 src/tasks/truth.ts 与相关分析逻辑仍然存在。需要确认 truth handler 现状，并把 truth_scan/truth_nav/truth_analyze/truth_to_story/truth_extract 接回默认 cli-engine/registry。

happy.desc: koala help 会重新出现 Truth 分组，且 truth_scan / truth_extract 在默认仓库根直接执行时不再报未知命令。

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/truth-cli-commands.json:4 WHY test_story proved default koala help and direct truth_scan/truth_extract execution are visible again in the default CLI. severity=low

edge.desc: 恢复后的 truth_scan / truth_analyze / truth_to_story 会继续复用现有 truth tasks，返回 filesScanned、entries、issues、suggestions 等核心结构，而不是临时占位文案。

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/truth-cli-commands.json:20 WHY test_story proved truth_scan summary, truth_analyze, and truth_to_story still return structured data when exercised through the default CLI. severity=low

adversarial.desc: 如果只补了 help 没补 handler，黑盒验证会直接暴露 handler not found 或未知命令，而不是假装命令已恢复。

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/truth-cli-commands.json:38 WHY test_story proved truth_nav and truth_to_story are wired to real handlers, not just mentioned in help. severity=medium

items.title: 补最小回归验证，防止 Truth 命令再次从默认 CLI 漏掉
items.context: 除了命令能跑，还要确保 koala help 能看到 Truth 分组，并且至少有一条脚本验证 truth_scan/truth_extract 等关键命令在默认 CLI 下可执行，避免继续依赖文档记忆或 wrapper 偶然行为。
relatedDocs: AGENTS.md#用户价值验收（优先于技术链路验证）

happy.desc: 最小验证脚本会同时检查 koala help 可见性与 truth_scan/truth_extract 的真实可执行性，防止 Truth 命令再次从默认 CLI 漏掉。

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/truth-cli-commands.json:54 WHY the end-to-end verifier script passed, covering Truth help visibility plus representative command execution in one black-box path. severity=low

edge.desc: 恢复后默认 CLI 下执行 truth_extract 会稳定写出 docs/requirements/extracted 下的提取产物，并返回与历史一致的完成提示。

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/truth-cli-commands.json:69 WHY test_story confirmed truth_extract writes extracted artifacts and keeps the truth_nav follow-up hint in default CLI output. severity=low

adversarial.desc: 如果未来有人再次把 Truth 命令从 MAIN_TOOLS 或 registry 漏掉，回归脚本会失败而不是等用户按文档手工撞到。

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/truth-cli-commands.json:86 WHY the npm-level regression script passed, so a future MAIN_TOOLS/registry disconnect for Truth will fail fast. severity=medium
